settings.text: A matting that provides standing comfort for workers, these mats come in a variety of marble tile designs and offer plenty of value with its high puncture resistance and durability.

settings.title:
SNOW, MUD
& DAMAGE
settings.subheading: CONTAIN THEM WITH THE FLOOR DEFENDER

settings.text: The underside of Floor Defender Pro Garage Containment Mats features a tatami grain pattern for increased traction. This patterned backing prevents these mats from lifting and allows them to retain their shape over extended periods of time. Also, the tatami grain patterned backing produces a smoother, less wrinkled surface than the smooth backed regular Floor Defender Garage Containment Mats.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE FLOOR PROTECTION
settings.title: NO MUDDY MESS
settings.text:
Dirt, Dust, and Debris are no problem as the Floor Defender Containment Mat catches it all and keeps it from being tracked into the house.

The Floor Defenders will hold up to 62 gallons of water at once and keep it off your floors until you are ready to safely empty it outside your garage.

settings.subtitle: ROLL OUT AND LAY DOWN
settings.title: HASSLE-FREE INSTALL
settings.text: Incredibly easy to use, the floor defenders unlike some other garage containments mats come ready to use. The single piece construction allows you to simply roll the mat out and lay it on your floor.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE FLOOR PROTECTION MATS
settings.title: PROTECT AGAINST CHEMICALS
settings.text: Keep oil, geese, anti-freeze, and other chemicals that may drain out of your car contained, and away from other possessions stored in the garage.

settings.subtitle: Improved
settings.title: EASY CLEAN UP
settings.text: Floor defenders are very easy to clean, simply drag the mat outside with all its contents and hose it down. In a matter of minutes, the mat is ready to be redeployed and used all over again.

settings.title: SIMPLE & COMPACT STORAGE
settings.text:
Although the Floor Defender Mats can be used year round, some of our customers prefer to only have the mats out in the winter.

Storing these mats after winter is incredibly easy. Simply roll them back up into a compact size and store it way in your garage.
